summary.en: A word is cut into separate pieces that light up in a shuffled order; it reads only when the last key pieces land, and then the whole word surges to full light.
summary.zh: 一个词被切成十几段互不相连的碎片，乱序逐段点亮；最后几段钥匙段落位才读得出来，随即整词通电满亮。

fits: The hook of an opening: a product name, one word or a big number whose recognition is the moment; once a film.
notFor: Text that must be read at once (a claim, a label); more than one word line; a light, busy ground where half-lit pieces do not glow.

overlaps.note: glyphs cycle through other glyphs and resolve; segment-reveal keeps every glyph and withholds parts of it
the word is written whole and continuously; segment-reveal withholds meaning, in discrete pieces

intent.en: Hold back recognition to make a hook: the viewer sees only mysterious pieces until the key ones land, and the moment the word is recognised is the payoff.
intent.zh: 把“认出来”压到最后做成钩子：观众前大半时间只看到神秘的碎段，钥匙段落位的那一刻认出是什么字，这一下就是回报。

content.en: One short word the viewer already knows (a product name, SHIP, LIVE, a big number): en 4–6 letters best, zh 2–4 chars; no other text.
content.zh: 一个观众本来就认识的短词（产品名、SHIP、LIVE、大数字）：英文 4–6 个字母最好，中文 2–4 字；不带其他文字。

fits.zh: 开场的钩子：认出这个词就是那一刻的产品名、单个词或大数字；一支片一次。

notFor.zh: 必须立刻读懂的文字（主张、标签）；超过一行字；浅色或花的底，半亮的碎段不发光。

pairs.note: a claim after the word is recognised

en: The word must be one the viewer already knows; a made-up word has no moment of recognition.
Keep it short; long words make the unreadable stretch hard to control and the pieces explode in number.
For the reveal let the lettering's own glow surge; a separate radial glow makes a dirty spot in the middle of the word.
zh: 必须是观众认识的词；生造词没有“认出”可言。
词要短；长词的不可读期难控制，碎段数量爆炸。
揭晓时让字形自己的泛光涌起；另画一团径向光会在字中间留下脏亮点。

upstream.name: 描边分段构建
upstream.summary: 断笔成字——标题拆成十几段互不相连的笔画乱序逐段点亮，前 70% 不可读，末段落位瞬间语义"啪"地成立
upstream.use: 开场吊悬念的产品名/大数字揭晓；一支片 ≤1 次；与 type-assembly/draw-svg-trace 分工：那些是"看着字被组装/描画"，本卡是"意义延迟揭晓"
upstream.energy: 低起中收（悬念型，落位帧是能量点）
